definitions.explanation: Skilled at achieving one's ends through deceit or manipulation; clever in a dishonest or underhanded way.

examples.japanese: {狡猾|こうかつ}な{策略|さくりゃく}。
{狡猾|こうかつ}な{政治家|せいじか}に{騙|だま}された。
examples.english: I was deceived by a cunning politician.

examples.japanese: あの{商人|しょうにん}は{狡猾|こうかつ}で{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: That merchant is famous for being sly.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{狡猾|こうかつ}な{策略|さくりゃく} - cunning scheme
・{狡猾|こうかつ}な{手口|てぐち} - sly trick
・{狡猾|こうかつ}な{人間|にんげん} - crafty person
・{狡猾|こうかつ}さ - cunningness (noun form)

NUANCE:
Strong negative connotation. Implies intelligence used for dishonest or manipulative purposes.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{巧妙|こうみょう} - clever, ingenious (more neutral, can be positive)
・ずる{賢|がしこ}い - sly, crafty (more casual)
・{悪|わる}{賢|がしこ}い - cunning (emphasizes bad intent)
